ABOUT

This website provides easy access to comprehensive, accurate and efficient prediction of ADMET profiles for chemicals. The prediction is founded on a high-quality database of 0.37M entries spanning 77 endpoints and Directed Message Passing Neural Network (DMPNN) framework.
